summary: Replace all seven Controller gallery screenshots with current console captures from a disposable demo Controller and update their captions. API impact: none.

guide.reason: Only gallery images and descriptions change; no operator workflow, permission, error or recovery instruction changes.

api.reason: The capture lab uses existing Controller session, site, enrollment, report, storage, network, media, VM and operation calls. It changes no Controller/Core command, response or client-facing API.

roadmap.reason: The gallery refresh changes no milestone or acceptance status.

state.reason: The screenshots and evidence are static website assets; the disposable lab adds no durable pool or Controller state.

verification.method: Run the disposable Controller capture script, inspect all seven resulting images, build and check the static website, exercise the gallery in Chromium at desktop/tablet/mobile widths, run the repository privacy test and documentation gate. Actual results and limits are recorded in the QA report.
